name: @drevops/nexus
description: Draw a Drupal content model from exported configuration, entirely in the browser.

scripts.assemble: rm -rf _site && mkdir _site && cp -R index.html src assets examples _site/
scripts.lint: eslint src tests eslint.config.js playwright.config.js && prettier --check "src/*.js" "tests/**/*.{js,mjs}" eslint.config.js playwright.config.js
scripts.lint-fix: eslint --fix src tests eslint.config.js playwright.config.js && prettier --write "src/*.js" "tests/**/*.{js,mjs}" eslint.config.js playwright.config.js
scripts.test: npm run test-unit && npm run test-e2e
